commits.subject: picard: derive fieldwise injectivity from Koszul exactness
commits.summary: **Non-circular flatness input.** Adjacent projective relation-fibre models and the exact divisor-fibre Koszul complex now force the successor multiplication injectivization to remain injective after tensoring with any carve-killing field.

commits.subject: picard: conjugate the relative Koszul boundary
commits.summary: **Boundary square.** The base change of the canonical relation Koszul boundary is now conjugate to the exact high-window Koszul boundary on every field-valued carve-chart fibre, assuming the two adjacent projective fibre models.

commits.subject: picard: conjugate relation steps on divisor fibres
commits.summary: **Relative Koszul bridge.** Scalar extension now distributes over the pair-indexed relation source, and each basis step is conjugate to multiplication on the canonical divisor fibre windows.
